products.description:
* WHAT...For the Small Craft Advisory, west winds 15 to 25 kt with
gusts up to 30 kt and seas 7 to 10 ft. For the Gale Watch,
southwest winds 25 to 35 kt with gusts up to 45 kt and seas 7 to
12 ft possible.

* WHERE...The coastal waters from Oregon Inlet to Ocracoke Inlet.

* WHEN...For the Small Craft Advisory, until 4 PM EST this
afternoon. For the Gale Watch, from late Sunday night through
Monday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds can cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Some infrequent gale force gusts (34kt)
will be possible over outer portions of these waters for a few
more hours.

products.areas: Northern Outer Banks; Ocracoke Island; Hatteras Island
products.description:
* WHAT...1 to 2 feet of inundation above ground level in low-
lying areas near shorelines and tidal waterways.

* WHERE...Areas along the beaches, Albemarle, Croatan, and
Roanoke Sounds, Kitty Hawk Bay, and adjacent tidal creeks.

* WHEN...Until 10 AM EST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...1 to 2 feet of inundation above ground level is
possible in low-lying areas near shorelines and tidal
waterways resulting in a low threat of property damage. Some
roads and low lying property including parking lots, parks,
lawns, and homes adjacent to the waterfront will experience
shallow flooding. Portions of NC-12 may be impacted.
products.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued November 28 at 5:00AM EST until November 28 at 10:00AM EST by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
products.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.
